contexts.text: Cold = no charity; and hot = much.
The heat of Jehovah against the nations () = opposition to evil.
Fury, anger, great heat () are nothing but evils of punishment on account of aversion and opposition to good and truth. Explained.
When falsity from evil approaches good, there arises heat; and when it approaches truth there takes place a collision.
If the heat of the will, that is, man's life's love, is hot from concupiscence of evil, it is then cold as to the affection of good.
